To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the class of properties that can be model-checked by UPPAAl is the smallest compositional property language that includes a simple safety property and (2) the class of safety properties that can be expressed using this language coincides with the class of safety characteristics properties for nodes of deterministic timed automata.

the class of properties that can be model-checked by reachability testing in timed automata is the same as the one of the properties expressible by the language of characteristics properties with regard to the ready simulation preorder.

the class of reachability testing properties coincides with the class of safety properties that are expressible by the least expressive composi- tional property language that can express the simple safety property that no reject state is ever reached.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
reachability testing is the most powerful technique for verifying timed properties of timed automata.

the class of properties characterizing the power reachability testing for systems of timed automata is the least expressive class of properties for the class of τ-free, non-branching deterministic timed automata that can express a safety property.

reachability testing is the computational engine of the UPPAAL model-checker, and that it is also the only engine available for the analysis of a class of properties that can be expressed in a language that includes the simple safety property just mentioned.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide a complete answer to the question "What is the power of reachablity testing for systems described as networks of timed automata?"
we have provided a complete characterization of those properties for which model checking can be reduced to the analysis of the reachability problem in the framework of timed automata.

reachability testing for deterministic timed automata is as powerful as model-checking with respect to a class of properties that is the largest compositional class of properties that can be expressed by test automata.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the class of properties that can be analysed by reachability testing for a class of timed systems is precisely the class of properties definable in the language of reachability properties.
reachability testing has a very high expressive power, which is only slightly lower than that of the full temporal logic.
reachability properties can be used to characterize a class of properties that is both expressive and efficiently testable.
